summary: 两项持续多年的恒河猴研究均发现，限制热量的猴子较少出现年龄相关疾病，但只有一项观察到相对对照组更长寿。研究者比较食物组成、对照组摄入量及“正常饮食”的定义，以解释不同结果。
logic: 由其他生物研究引出灵长类试验
健康结论一致而寿命仍待比较

paragraphs.brief: 美国威斯康辛大学的一个小组发表的研究表明，恒河猴也以受卡路里限制的饮食维持更长的生命。
sentences: Calorie restriction, or ‘semi-starvation’ as some refer to it, has been proven to extend lifespan in many living organisms from yeast to mice, but the picture for primates, including humans, is not so clear.
已经证明，在很多活生物体中，Calorie限制，或有些人提到的`半饥饿 ' 将寿命从酵母延长到小鼠，但灵长类动物，包括人类的图象并不十分清楚。
Research published by a team at the University of Wisconsin in the United States shows that rhesus monkeys also live longer on a calorie-restricted diet.
美国威斯康辛大学的一个小组发表的研究表明，恒河猴也以受卡路里限制的饮食维持更长的生命。
But those findings disagree with research by the National Institute on Aging (NIA) in Maryland, also in the United States.
也在美国：“但是，这些调查结果与马里兰国家老龄问题研究所的研究不相符。”
Rozalyn Anderson, of the Wisconsin team, says the research is not intended as a recommendation of calorie restriction.
威斯康辛队的Rozalyn Anderson 说研究的目的并不是建议卡路里限制。
‘I find the idea monumentally unattractive!’ she says.
”她说：我发现这个想法极不吸引人。
‘We study it because it is so effective at delaying ageing and the onset of age-related disease.
我们研究它，因为它能有效推迟老龄化和与年龄有关的疾病的发病。
It’s a way to tease out what it is that creates increased disease vulnerability as a function of age.’
这是一种取笑导致疾病脆弱性因年龄而增加的方法。

paragraphs.brief: 这两个小组在1980年代后期开始对恒河猴进行长期试验，以确定卡路里限制是否会延长灵长类动物的寿命。
sentences: Both groups started long-term trials on rhesus monkeys in the late 1980s to determine whether calorie restriction would extend the lifespan of primates.
这两个小组在1980年代后期开始对恒河猴进行长期试验，以确定卡路里限制是否会延长灵长类动物的寿命。
In mice, many experiments had come to the same finding: feed them a diet with 30% fewer calories and see a lifespan extension of 40%.
在小鼠身上，许多实验都得出了同样的结论：以低30%的卡路里喂它们饮食，延长寿命40%。

The monkey trials were set up in a similar way: researchers took the calorie content of a standard monkey diet, cut it by 30% (while continuing to supply all essential nutrients) and monitored whether those monkeys lived longer, healthier lives than those on the standard diet.
猴子试验也是以类似的方式进行的：研究人员将标准猴子饮食的卡路里含量削减30%(同时继续提供所有基本营养物质)，并监测这些猴子是否比标准饮食更健康地生活。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，2012年国家海洋评估的结果出现了一个截然不同的结论：他们的猴子没有活得比控制时间长，尽管他们更健康。
sentences: In 2009, with the monkeys approaching old age, preliminary findings of the two trials started coming in.
2009年，随着猴子们接近老年，两项试验的初步结果开始出现。
For the Wisconsin monkeys, calorie restriction seemed to be working.
对于威斯康辛猴子来说，卡路里限制似乎有效。
Compared to well-fed control animals, the lean monkeys were living longer and suffering less from the diseases of ageing: diabetes, heart disease and brain diseases.
较之食不果腹的控制动物，瘦猴子的寿命更长，受老龄疾病 -- -- 糖尿病、心脏病和脑病 -- -- 影响较少。
However, in 2012 the NIA results emerged with a dramatically different conclusion: their monkeys were not living any longer than the controls, although they were healthier.
然而，2012年国家海洋评估的结果出现了一个截然不同的结论：他们的猴子没有活得比控制时间长，尽管他们更健康。

paragraphs.brief: 威斯康辛团体的最新结果证实，它们受热量限制的猴子的寿命比控制时间长。
sentences: The Wisconsin group’s latest results confirm that their calorie-restricted monkeys are living longer than the controls.
威斯康辛团体的最新结果证实，它们受热量限制的猴子的寿命比控制时间长。
They also offer a possible explanation of why the two groups’ findings don’t agree, and that lies in the treatment of the control group.
也说明为何两组结论不一致，并取决于对控制组的处理。
The Wisconsin study began with monkeys in early adulthood.
威斯康星研究从幼年的猴子开始
Initially, all the monkeys were allowed to eat as much as they liked.
一开始，所有猴子都可以吃他们喜欢吃的

A few months into the trial, the monkeys were placed into one of two groups: the controls (who continued to be fed as much as they wished) and the calorie-restricted monkeys (who were given an individualised diet of 30% less than they were previously eating).
在试验的几个月里，猴子被分成两类：控制(他们继续按自己的意愿喂食)和限制热量的猴子(他们得到的个性化饮食比他们以前吃的少30%)。

paragraphs.brief: 首先，控制猴子的组不允许吃他们想要的。
sentences: The NIA study differed in two ways.
NIA的研究有两种不同方式。
First, the control group of monkeys were not allowed to eat as much as they wished.
首先，控制猴子的组不允许吃他们想要的。
They were given a diet considered to represent a normal calorie count, while the calorie-restricted monkeys were fed 30% less than that.
他们得到的饮食被认为是正常的卡路里数，而受卡路里限制的猴子的喂养量则比这个少30%。
Second, whereas the Wisconsin monkeys were given highly processed food high in sucrose, making it easy to standardise, the NIA diet was based on whole grains, fish oils, and was very low in sugar.
其次，威斯康辛猴子的食品加工量很高，因此易于标准化，而国家食品管理局的饮食则以整颗谷物和鱼油为基础，糖含量很低。
These different settings for the normal control diet may provide an explanation of why the two groups showed different results.
正常控制饮食的这些不同环境可以解释为什么这两个群体的结果不同。

paragraphs.brief: 威斯康星集团可能实际上研究了 " 过度食用 " 的影响。
sentences: The Wisconsin group may in effect have studied the effects of ‘overeating’.
威斯康星集团可能实际上研究了 " 过度食用 " 的影响。
Their control animals weighed up to 10% more than average for their age and gender.
它们的控制动物在年龄和性别上比平均水平高出10%。
Compared to them, the calorie-restricted animals not only suffered fewer diseases, they lived longer.
与它们相比，受卡路里限制的动物不仅患病较少，而且寿命更长。
Julie Mattison, head of the NIA study, observes that an overweight person who goes to a fast food restaurant every day will obviously benefit if their calories are cut back by 30%.
NIA研究的负责人Julie Madison指出，如果卡路里减少30%，那么每天去快餐店的超重者显然会受益。

paragraphs.brief: NIA研究将他们认为是“标准”热量摄入的猴子喂养了他们的控制性猴子，并且发现喂养的猴子的寿命为30%以下。
sentences: The NIA study fed their control monkeys what they considered a ‘standard’ caloric intake and saw that longevity for monkeys that were fed 30% less was the same.
NIA研究将他们认为是“标准”热量摄入的猴子喂养了他们的控制性猴子，并且发现喂养的猴子的寿命为30%以下。
But in Anderson’s view, the NIA control monkeys were not fed enough; the NIA was calorie restricting both groups of animals.
但安德森认为，NIA控制猴子的食物不足；NIA是限制两种动物的热量。
Their older female control monkeys, for example, weighed nearly 20% less than the national average.
例如，她们年纪较大的雌性控制猴子的体重比全国平均水平低近20%。
Indeed, Anderson points out that several of the NIA control monkeys have lived past the age of 40, far exceeding the 27-year average lifespan for captive rhesus monkeys.
事实上，安德森指出，一些NIA控制的猴子已经活过40岁，远远超过了被俘的瑞瑟猴27年的平均寿命。
‘That’s the maximum lifespan ever detected for the species, so the idea that their intervention is doing nothing is really at odds with the data,’ says Anderson.
安德森说，“这是物种最大的寿命期，所以认为他们的干预没有做任何事情与数据完全不相容，”

paragraphs.brief: 然而，根据Leonie Heilbronn的说法，这两个群体都没有正确的标准饮食概念，他在澳大利亚阿德莱德大学研究卡路里限制和健康老龄化问题。
sentences: However, neither group had the right notion of a standard diet according to Leonie Heilbronn, who researches calorie restriction and healthy ageing at the University of Adelaide in Australia.
然而，根据Leonie Heilbronn的说法，这两个群体都没有正确的标准饮食概念，他在澳大利亚阿德莱德大学研究卡路里限制和健康老龄化问题。
Heilbronn points out that the NIA controls were a very healthy set of monkeys and leaner than a control monkey should be.
海尔布罗恩指出，NIA的控制是一群非常健康的猴子，比控制猴子应该更瘦。
On the other hand, she notes, the Wisconsin controls were a little bigger than they had to be.
另一方面，她指出，威斯康辛的控制略大于他们必须做的。
On balance, Heilbronn agrees with the Wisconsin researcher’s argument.
总的来说，海尔布隆同意威斯康星州研究员的论点。
‘I think these studies suggest calorie restriction definitely will increase lifespan,’ she says.
她表示：「我认为这些研究显示卡路里限制肯定会延长寿命。

paragraphs.brief: 这两项研究都认为，切割卡路里有利于健康——在这两种情况下，受卡路里限制的猴子与老龄化有关的疾病较少。
sentences: Both studies agree that cutting calories is beneficial to health — in both cases the calorie-restricted monkeys had fewer diseases related to ageing.
这两项研究都认为，切割卡路里有利于健康——在这两种情况下，受卡路里限制的猴子与老龄化有关的疾病较少。
As to the question of whether calorie restriction extends lifespan in primates, Anderson and Mattison are currently working together to compare the two studies’ raw data.
至于卡路里限制是否延长灵长类动物寿命的问题，Anderson和Mattison目前正在共同努力，比较这两项研究的原始数据。
They plan to co-publish a joint analysis.
他们计划共同出版一份联合分析。
The current data conflict will ultimately provide deeper insights into ageing, Anderson predicts.
安德森预测，目前的数据冲突最终将更深入地了解老龄化问题。
‘The fact the two studies were set up differently, asking the same question in different ways — I think we will gain maximally from that.’
“这两个研究是不同的，以不同的方式提出同样的问题—— 我认为我们会从中得益最大。”

items.en: a reference to studies based on the same level of calorie reduction with different animals
items.zh: 参考根据不同动物的同样卡路里减少水平进行的研究
items.why: 题干要“相同幅度的热量减少在不同动物上的研究”。B段先说鼠的实验统一减少30%,再说猴的试验以相同方式设置 (同样30%),完全对应。

items.en: a comment that some control monkeys in one study reached an older age than normal for animals of their kind
items.zh: 一种说法是，在一项研究中，一些控制性猴子的年龄比正常动物的年龄大。
items.why: 题干要“对照组某些猴子高于同类正常寿命的评论"。G段明确: 对照猴活过 40 岁，远超27年的平均寿命。

items.en: distinctions between the types of food in each study that may have led to a contrast in findings
items.zh: 每项研究对食物种类的区分可能导致研究结果的对比
items.why: 题干要“食物类型差异并可能导致结果对比"。E段逐点对比两研究的食物组成 (高蔗糖加工食品 vs. 全谷物/鱼油/低糖) 并明确说这或可解释结果差异。

items.en: examples of health problems which monkeys on calorie-restricted diets were less likely to get
items.zh: 受卡路里限制饮食的猴子较少获得保健问题的例子
items.why: 题干要“热量限制猴子更不易得到的健康问题例子"。C 段给出具体疾病: 糖尿病、心脏病、脑部疾病。

items.en: a researcher’s negative opinion of a calorie-restricted diet
items.zh: 研究人员对卡路里限量饮食的负面看法
items.why: 题干要“研究者对热量限制的负面看法*。A段安德森直言“我觉得这个想法极不吸引人”,即负面态度。

items.en: a reference to the stage in the monkeys’ lives at which research commenced in one study
items.zh: 提到猴子生命中的阶段，在一项研究中开始研究
items.why: 题干要“研究开始时猴子所处生命阶段*。D段直接给出: 在成年早期开始。

items.en: It is good that the two studies took dissimilar approaches.
items.zh: 这两项研究采取了不同的做法，这是件好事。

items.en: Neither study used diets that are typical for monkeys.
items.zh: 研究中也没有使用猴子特有的饮食。

items.en: Calorie restriction is a method of finding out about health issues connected with ageing.
items.zh: Calorie限制是了解与老龄化有关的健康问题的一种方法。

items.en: Calorie reduction will have a positive effect on people who have unhealthy diets.
items.zh: 减少卡路里会对那些有不健康饮食的人产生积极的影响。

items.en: Monkeys whose calories were restricted suffered fewer diseases that are associated with the ________ process.
items.zh: 热量摄入受限的猴子，较少患上与________过程有关的疾病。
items.why: 题干“与…过程相关的疾病" 即“ageing (衰老) 过程”。

items.en: Anderson and Mattison have undertaken research to determine if a calorie-restricted diet increases primates’ ________.
items.zh: 安德森和马蒂森开展研究，考察限制热量摄入的饮食能否延长灵长类动物的________。
items.why: 摘要句式为“jincrease primates’ ”,与原文“extend lifespan”同义替换，词源自原文。

items.en: Although there is a ________ between the two sets of data, Anderson believes they will help researchers reach a better understanding.
items.zh: 尽管两组数据之间存在________，安德森认为，它们仍有助于研究人员加深理解。
items.why: 回到对应内容“安德森预测，目前的数据冲突最终将更深入地了解老龄化问题”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: reached an older age than normal
题干的“超过通常年龄”由原文的具体基准支撑，若干对照猴活过40岁，远超27岁的平均寿命。
题干从研究者的做法说“两项研究途径不同”，原文从实验的安排说“设置不同”。
两处都在说明疾病与衰老有关，这组关系词本身不表示衰老直接导致了所有疾病。
points: 题干要“研究者对热量限制的负面看法*。A段安德森直言“我觉得这个想法极不吸引人”,即负面态度。
题干“与…过程相关的疾病" 即“ageing (衰老) 过程”。
clauses: Research published by a team at the University of Wisconsin in the United States shows ….
“that rhesus monkeys also live longer on a calorie-restricted diet”补足 shows 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 shows 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
连接词 because 引出“because it is so effective at delaying ageing and the onset of age-related disease”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: The latest in a conflicting series of studies suggests calorie restriction could potentially slow ageing in humans
一系列相互冲突的研究的最新研究表明，卡路里限制可能会减缓人类的老龄化。
